settings.resync_confirm:
GGCalendar will download again all the events of all the connected Google calendars.

• It can take some time (minutes with many events) and uses the internet connection.
• Local events will be aligned with Google: changes already sent but changed elsewhere are overwritten with Google's version.
• Events that no longer exist on Google will be removed from GGCalendar.
• Local changes not yet sent are sent first and are not lost; if you are offline they stay in the queue.
• The resync starts when the settings are closed.
